summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K on October 28, 2026 reporting that subsidiary Arch Reinsurance Ltd., as borrower, entered Amendment No. 6 to its Letter of Credit Facility Agreement with Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets plc as Administrative and L/C Agent. The amendment extends letters of credit for the 2027 underwriting year, pushes the Availability Period end from May 31, 2026 to May 31, 2027, and raises the maximum Incremental Commitment from $50 million to $200 million under the $700 million facility. The filing is an ordinary credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; items 1.01, 2.03 and 9.01 apply. No deal economics, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle are present; monitor renewal mechanics only.
